facts.fact: Law 2011-003 (Civil Status Code), article 18, provides that declarations of civil status events are recorded immediately in the database of the central system, with the supporting documents archived physically and electronically at the Citizen Welcome Centre where the declaration is made (articles 5 and 15); this is the legal rule, not a report of deployment.

facts.fact: Law 2011-003 provides that birth, marriage, divorce and death information is integrated in the National Population Register (article 2), with births declared within 60 days (article 34) and deaths within 30 days (article 50) at the Citizen Welcome Centre and recorded in the central database (article 18); this is the legal rule, not a report of deployment.
facts.system: السجل الوطني للسكان (Registre National de la Population) / قاعدة بيانات النظام المركزي

facts.fact: Law 2011-003, article 6, provides for a body created by decree to set up and run the National Population Register, receive declarations of civil status events, issue the resulting acts and manage the infrastructure and information systems; article 72 keeps Decree 2010-150 of 6 July 2010 in force.

systems.country_label: السجل الوطني للسكان (س.و.س), entered at مركز استقبال المواطنين (Centre d'accueil des citoyens)
systems.owner: the body created by decree under article 6 (Decree 2010-150 of 6 July 2010)
systems.tiers: Citizen Welcome Centre, at least one in every moughataa and where needed at diplomatic and consular missions (article 5); the centre head is a civil status officer (article 13); the same register holds fingerprints, facial data and photograph and gives each registered person a unique national identification number (articles 2 and 4); no act may be issued to a person not in the register (article 9)

systems.country_label: سجل الولادات (births register) and سجل الوفيات (deaths register) kept in public and private health facilities
systems.tiers: each health facility records births and deaths as they occur, gives the family an extract to present at the Citizen Welcome Centre, and must send a periodic statement to the centre of its locality (articles 35 and 52); the law does not say in what form

systems.owner: the body created by decree under article 6
systems.tiers: the body may set up secure systems for electronic certificates and signatures; electronic writing has the evidential force of paper (articles 7 and 8)
